race.description: Mt Augustus 'Big Rock Feast' 29th Aug Hcp (56+)
race.comment: IRONCLAD BOY (4) disappointed last start at 1400m but was in top order prior. Back to 1200m now, but carries no weight with the claim of O'Donnell and he gets in right down in the weights. Expecting a better showing this time around. LIMAHULI (3) started at $3.10 last time and ran below expectations, finishing fifth and beaten 6 lengths at this track over 1400m. Suitably placed so anticipating a big run this time. SHE IS ALL MAGIC (12) raced on the speed last start over this course and distance and stuck on well to finish third, beaten 1.75 lengths. Likely improver with bright prospects. LADY COCO (6) tackled a dirt track for the first time last start and finished ninth at her initial outing for the Ray Malpass stable over 1205m at Roebourne. Good record at this journey with two wins and four minor placings from nine starts and is a leading contender. SUNSHINE TAFE (5) can improve with the fresh run under her belt.
